Legal

Privacy Policy

Effective date: October 6, 2026

Eryx Labs (“Eryx Labs,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have. By using our website or submitting information to us, you agree to this Policy.

1.Who We Are

Eryx Labs is a Utah-based marketing company that builds and manages customer-acquisition systems — including paid advertising, lead capture, tracking, and follow-up — for local service businesses across the United States.

2.Information We Collect

Information you give us

  • Contact and business details you submit through our forms — such as your name, phone number, email address, business name, and industry.
  • The content of any messages, emails, texts, or call notes you share with us.
  • Information you provide when you become a client or communicate with us about our services.

Information collected automatically

  • Usage data such as pages viewed, links clicked, referring site, and time spent, collected through cookies and similar technologies.
  • Device and technical data such as IP address, browser type, and general location (city/region).

3.How We Use Your Information

  • To respond to your inquiry and schedule your strategy call.
  • To provide, manage, and improve our services for you.
  • To contact you by phone, email, or SMS about your inquiry and the services you requested (see Section 5).
  • To analyze and improve our website and marketing.
  • To comply with legal obligations and enforce our agreements.

4.How We Share Information

We do not sell your personal information. We do not share it with third parties for their own marketing. We may share information only with:

  • Service providers who help us operate (e.g., CRM, scheduling, hosting, analytics, and advertising platforms), bound to protect your data.
  • Legal and safety recipients when required by law or to protect our rights.
Mobile information is never shared. No mobile information (including phone numbers and SMS consent) will be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes.

5.Text Messaging (SMS)

If you provide your phone number and opt in, we may send you transactional and/or promotional text messages. Message frequency varies and message and data rates may apply. You can opt out at any time by replying STOP, or get help by replying HELP. Full details are in our SMS Terms.

6.Cookies & Analytics

We use cookies and similar technologies to operate the site, remember preferences, measure performance, and support advertising (such as Meta and Google tools). You can control cookies through your browser settings; disabling them may affect site functionality.

7.Data Retention

We keep your information for as long as needed to provide our services, respond to you, and meet legal, tax, or accounting requirements. When no longer needed, we delete or anonymize it.

8.Your Rights & Choices

  • Request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information.
  • Opt out of marketing emails (unsubscribe) or texts (reply STOP).
  • Depending on your state (e.g., California residents under the CCPA/CPRA), you may have additional rights to know, delete, and opt out of “sale”/“sharing” — note we do not sell or share personal information for others’ marketing.

To exercise any right, contact us using the details below.

9.Data Security

We use reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect your information. No method of transmission or storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

10.Third-Party Links

Our site may link to third-party websites or platforms (such as our scheduling tool). We are not responsible for their privacy practices; review their policies separately.

11.Children’s Privacy

Our services are intended for business owners and are not directed to anyone under 18. We do not knowingly collect information from children.

12.Changes to This Policy

We may update this Policy from time to time. The “Effective date” above reflects the latest version. Continued use of our site after changes means you accept the updated Policy.
